mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Ahri has increased movement speed while {{Spell_AhriQ_Jade_Name}} is in flight.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Gains a charge of Essence Theft whenever a spell hits an enemy. Upon reaching maximum charges, the next spell restores Ahri's Health.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Ability hits on enemies grant Ahri a charge of <spellName>Essence Theft</spellName> (max: 3 charges per ability). Upon reaching @MaxStacks@ charges, her next Ability consumes them to restore <healing>@HealPerHit@ Health</healing> per enemy hit.
This unit takes increased damage from Ahri.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Ahri blows a kiss that damages and Charms the first enemy hit. They also take more damage from her for several seconds.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Ahri blows a kiss that deals <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage> and <status>Charms</status> the first enemy hit for @CharmDuration@ seconds. They also take @DamageAmp@% more damage from her for @DamageAmpDuration@ seconds.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Essence Theft</titleLeft><mainText>After Ahri hits with 9 spells, her next spell has 35% Spell Vamp.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Charmed</titleLeft><mainText>This unit cannot attack despite being taunted and must walk towards Ahri.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Ahri blows a kiss that damages and Charms the first enemy hit. They also take more damage from her for several seconds.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Ahri blows a kiss that deals <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage> and <status>Charms</status> the first enemy hit for @CharmDuration@ seconds. They also take @DamageAmp@% more damage from her for @DamageAmpDuration@ seconds.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Ahri sends out and pulls back her orb, dealing magic damage on the way out and true damage on the way back.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Ahri throws then pulls back her orb, dealing <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage> on the way out and <trueDamage>@TotalDamage@ true damage</trueDamage> on the way back.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Ahri dashes forward and fires essence bolts, damaging 3 nearby enemies (prioritizes Champions). Spirit Rush can be cast up to three times before going on cooldown.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Ahri nimbly dashes, firing 3 essence bolts at nearby enemies, prioritizing champions. These bolts deal <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage> each. <spellName>Spirit Rush</spellName> can be <recast>Recast</recast> up to 2 more times within 10 seconds.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Fox-Fire</titleLeft><mainText>Ahri has Fox-Fires surrounding her which will seek out and attack nearby enemies.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Ahri releases three fox-fires, that lock onto and attack nearby enemies.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Ahri releases 3 fox-fires that seek nearby enemies and deal <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>, reduced to <magicDamage>@HalfDamage@ damage</magicDamage> beyond the first.
